label: D1 in the last ~10 trials of the episode while on an a2 streak (after a common a2 trial)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass), and almost only in episode trials 90-99 (99% of mass; none before trial 80), where the value head is at its lowest (all activity is in the bottom value bin, <5.22), so it looks like an end-of-episode signal. Within that window it fires when the agent is on an a2 streak. The upcoming choice is a2 (99.8% of mass), the previous choice was a2, and the previous transition was common, not rare (rare gives a lift of only 0.1x). The D1 policy logit sits in a moderate a2-preferring band (-4.4 to -1.5). The only FUTURE variable is action at D1, which is the agent own upcoming choice and so is allowed. An observed-only version, ep_trial>=90 plus a choice logit in [-4.44,-1.52], scored dev F1 0.78. Previous reward 1 raises the rate (86% of mass), but requiring it cuts recall. In the example windows the activation ramps up over consecutive rewarded common a2 trials toward the end of the episode and drops after an unrewarded or rare trial. That is from the examples, not a systematic check. It does not fire at GO or D2, on a1 choices, after rare transitions, or before trial ~88. Dev scores: P 0.65, R 0.94, F1 0.77, mass recall 0.98. Precision is incomplete because many late-episode a2 D1 steps stay silent, probably those early in a streak or after no reward.
